# Amplitude

> Amplitude is the digital analytics platform that helps product, data, and marketing teams understand user behavior, ship better experiences, and grow their business. Amplitude provides product analytics, experimentation (feature flags and A/B testing), session replay, web analytics, and customer data platform (CDP) capabilities.

- Website: https://amplitude.com
- Developer Documentation: https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com
- API Reference: https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/

## Developer Documentation

- [Analytics Documentation](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/): Documentation for event tracking, instrumentation, and analytics setup.
- [Experiment Documentation](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/experiment/): Docs for feature flags, experiments, and evaluation workflows.
- [Session Replay Documentation](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/session-replay/): Implementation docs for capturing and reviewing session replays.
- [CDP Documentation](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/data/): Documentation for customer data collection and routing workflows.
- [SDKs Overview](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/): Overview of Amplitude SDKs for client and server instrumentation.
- [Guides](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/): Practical implementation guides for common analytics tasks.

## SDKs

- [Browser SDK 2](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/browser-2/): JavaScript browser SDK for web event tracking and user analytics.
- [Node.js SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/node-js/): Server-side Node.js SDK for sending events to Amplitude.
- [Python SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/python/): Python SDK for backend event ingestion and analytics workflows.
- [Go SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/go/): Go SDK for sending analytics events from backend services.
- [Java SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/java/): Java SDK for server-side analytics event tracking.
- [iOS SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/ios-swift/): Swift SDK for instrumenting iOS applications with Amplitude analytics.
- [Android SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/android-kotlin/): Kotlin-based Android SDK for mobile analytics instrumentation.
- [React Native SDK](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/sdks/react-native/): SDK for tracking analytics in React Native applications.

## APIs

- [HTTP V2 API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/http-v2-api/): Send event data to Amplitude over HTTP.
- [Batch Event Upload API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/batch-event-upload-api/): Upload events in batches for higher-throughput ingestion.
- [Identify API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/identify-api/): Update user properties without sending event records.
- [Group Identify API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/group-identify-api/): Update group properties for account or organization analytics.
- [Export API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/export-api/): Export raw event data from Amplitude for downstream processing.
- [Dashboard REST API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/dashboard-rest-api/): Query chart and dashboard data programmatically.
- [User Profile API](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/apis/user-profile-api/): Retrieve Amplitude user profiles through API access.

## Implementation Guides

- [Instrumentation Guide](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/instrumentation/): Best practices for planning and implementing event tracking.
- [Tracking Plan](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/data/tracking-plan/): Define and manage a consistent analytics taxonomy and schema.
- [User and Group Properties](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/user-properties-and-events/): Understand events, user properties, and group-level modeling.
- [Identity Resolution](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/identify-users/): Guidance for identifying users across anonymous and authenticated states.
- [Data Backfill](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/backfill/): Strategies for importing historical data into Amplitude.
- [Debugging](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/analytics/guides/debugging/): Troubleshoot instrumentation and event delivery issues.
- [Session Replay Setup](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/session-replay/session-replay-plugin/): Configure session replay capture alongside analytics tracking.
- [Experiment Quickstart](https://www.docs.developers.amplitude.com/experiment/quickstart/): Get started with feature flags and experimentation workflows.
